title: Heroes v1
description: Body of GET /api/heroes: the whole fixed hero roster, always exactly 11 items in roster order (the order of backend/specter_arena/specters/heroes.json and of specter.v2 heroId), so a client can show a hero no bot holds yet from the backend's one copy of the hero text. heroId is the specter.v2 identifier, referenced and not repeated. name, epithet and personality are the same fixed authored text a specter.v2 carries, with the same limits. assignedCount is how many bot bindings were ever given this hero, counting bindings whose bot no longer shows in the roster, because a hero is never reclaimed; assigned is true exactly when assignedCount is above 0. Both are counts of facts about hero assignment only: a hero is cosmetic and implies no role, capability, lane or tier, and nothing here is an agent setting, permission, experience value or level. A newer major fails closed.
